Voice mode hears through the window

            
The window listens and speaks itself and cancels its own echo, so you can talk over it on speakers. Off: voice mode uses this PC's mic and speakers directly.

          

          

        

        

          

            
Speakers mode

            
For /listen in the terminal on speakers. Say "JARVIS, stop" to cut in.

The processor is fast enough.

          

          
        

        

          

            
Voice

How fast the voice talks. 1.0 is the default.

          

          

            
            1.0x
          

        

        

          

            
Microphone

Speech recognition

            
Larger is more accurate and slower. Names ending in .en understand English only; pick one from the second group for other languages.

          

          
          

        

        

          

            
Spoken language

            
On detect, Inglen listens in the language of the voice you picked, and with an English voice works out the language from what you say. Naming one is a little faster and more accurate when you always speak it.

          

          
        

        

          

            
Listening runs on

            
The graphics card is much faster. The first time, Inglen asks, then downloads what it needs (about 500 MB, once) and shows it in Downloads.

          

          
        


        


        

        
Behavior


        
        

          

            
Agent name

            
What the assistant is called: in chat, in its voice and in the wake word. It also names the workspace folder. Letters, digits and spaces, up to 20.

          

          

            
            
          

        


        

          

            
Show reasoning by default

            
Show the model's thinking before its answer, for models that think. Replies can take much longer.

          

          

        


        
        

          

            
Auto's reviewer

            
In Auto, a step that would stop to ask goes ahead when what you said clearly asked for exactly it. Shutting down, disks, accounts, security settings, hidden commands and saved passwords always ask.

            
checking…

            
          

          

        

        

          

            
Lock reads to workspace

            
Inglen can read files anywhere on this PC and only ever writes inside its workspace. Turn this on to keep reading inside the workspace too.

          

          
        

        

          

            
Remember things on its own

            
After a reply, Inglen notes lasting facts from the chat into memory. Off, it only saves when you ask.

          

          

        

        

          

            
House rules

            
Things it should always or never do, kept in a file it rereads every turn.

          

          
        

        

          

            
Import memory from ChatGPT / Claude

            
Paste what another AI knows about you - Inglen saves the durable facts (deduped). No account or keys; just copy the prompt, send it there, paste the reply back.

          

          

            
List everything you know or remember about me as plain bullet points, one fact per line, with no introduction: my name, work, preferences, projects, important dates and the people in my life.

            
          

          
          

            
            
          

        


        

        Advanced
        

          

            
Review every command

            
In Auto, also check the commands that would run without asking. Slower: each one waits for the reviewer.

          

          

        

        

          

            
Reasoning effort

            
How hard a cloud model thinks when reasoning is on. Model default lets it decide.

          

          
        

        
        

          

            
Keep local model loaded when switching to cloud

            
Off frees graphics memory when you switch to a cloud model. On keeps the local one ready, so switching back is instant.

          

          

        

        

          

            
Migrate from another agent

            
Bring memory and skills over from Hermes or OpenClaw. API keys are never copied. Dry-run shows what would change before anything does.

          

          

            

              
              
              
            

            

              
              
            

          

        


        
Tool permissions

        
What each risky tool does when called: Ask, Allow or Deny. A denied tool is hidden from the model. Read-only tools are always allowed.

Load my last model at start

            
When Inglen starts, it loads the last local model you used.

          

          

        


        

          

            
Default context window · built-in server only

            
Only applies when Inglen runs its own llama.cpp server and loads a GGUF that has no saved config yet. LM Studio / Ollama / cloud brains set their own context - this is ignored for them. Higher = more headroom but more KV-cache VRAM.

          

          
          
        


        

          

            
Idle auto-unload

            
Unload the model after this many idle minutes to free graphics memory. 0 keeps it loaded.

          

          
        


        

          

            
Models folder

            
Where models are downloaded and scanned. Point it at a drive with space if your C is full, and your chats and memory stay where they are. Applies on the next launch; move existing models there or drop new ones in.

          

          

            
            
          

        


        

          Default context / port / idle changes apply on the next server start. Hit Restart above to act on the new value now.
        


        

        Advanced
        

          

            
Concurrent agents · built-in server only

            
How many requests the server handles at once. Automatic picks from your graphics memory (one under 14 GB, two at 16 GB, more above). At 1 a team of sub-agents queues and finishes one after another. Each extra slot reserves another full context window of KV-cache VRAM, so Inglen steps this back down at load time if your card can't hold it. Takes effect the next time the built-in server loads a model (Eject and reload, or restart Inglen); changing it mid-session does not touch the running server.

          

          
        

        

          

            
Server port

            
Default 1234. Change only if you have a port conflict.

Connectors

        

          Reach Inglen from your phone or your inbox.
        

        


        
        

          

            
Email · read + send

            
Let Inglen read your inbox and send replies when you ask. Use an app password, not your login one (Gmail: Account, Security, App passwords, needs 2-step on). Servers auto-detect for Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud and Fastmail. Stays on this PC, and nothing is read until you ask.

          

          

            
            
            

              
              
              
              
            

          

        


        
        

          

            
Telegram · recommended

            
In Telegram, message @BotFather, send /newbot and paste the token here. Then message your bot: it gives you a code, and you let yourself in below.

          

          

            
            
            

              
              
              
            

            
Saved bots start automatically on launch. Use Start to bring it online right now.

          

        


        
        

          

            
Discord · recommended

            
discord.com/developers, New Application, Bot, copy the token. DM the bot: it gives you a code to let yourself in below. In a server it answers when @mentioned.

          

          

            
            
            

              
              
              
            

            
Saved bots start automatically on launch. Use Start to bring it online right now.

          

        


        
        

          

            
Send reminders to my phone too

            
Each reminder also goes to the Telegram or Discord above, to whoever is let in there first.

          

          

        


        
        

          

            
WhatsApp · experimental

            
Unofficial link to a real account. Meta can ban the number for automation, so use a spare number, not your main. Pairing shows a QR the first time it starts.

          

          

            
            
            

              
              
              
            

            
Saved bots start automatically on launch. Use Start to show the pairing QR now.

          

        


        
        

          

            
Your own connectors

            
Any other chat app, from a small Python file in your workspace's connectors folder. Inglen adds who may talk, the questions before risky steps, voice notes and files.
